semantics.function: out equals the number of input bits equal to 1 for binary input vectors
semantics.timing: Combinational; the original specifies a population count circuit with no clock or cycle latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified
semantics.initialization: No state or initialization required; output follows the input after combinational settling

numeric.interpretation: Unsigned count; all possible counts fit in 8 bits

verification.oracle: Independent count of set bit positions from the original population-count definition
verification.sampling: Drive input then wait one simulation time unit before checking combinational output
verification.cases: Zero, all ones, every one-hot and one-cold vector, all counts 0 through 255, alternating patterns, random binary vectors
verification.failure: Fatal mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS printed only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X or Z input bits is not specified; development checks target binary vectors.
